actual: Both S0/S2 real canonical and preview WEBGL_lose_context events restore current frames with unchanged snapshots and correct pixels, but qualified completion service reports unknown-abandon / physical_loss=false.
mechanism: WebGlSurfaceProvider::Impl::service checks get_context_attributes first. Pinned Emscripten returns INVALID_TARGET for both deleted registry handles and a live lost context whose getContextAttributes() is null. The physical-loss branch is consequently bypassed.
native_retirement_safety: Fail-closed unknown-abandon retains unresolved charges; no false successful completion is claimed. This does not meet the frozen physical-loss classification/recovery contract.
repair_direction: Validate live context registry independently (e.g. pinned drawing-buffer-size API), then distinguish actual context loss from deletion; retain old native-handle reuse negatives. This is a proposed repair, not implemented or verified in this subject.
frozen_window: All four authorized IDs consumed and closed. No source/driver/SDK changes or browser retries after freeze; a new control repair/reverification package is needed.
